owner_and_capability: Root composition (ADR 0059): the server root, the Worker root and the test roots build every owner as a local value in the build order of the owner graph and pass it as a constructor argument; api.serviceGraph, its stages, the *Wiring structs, IdentityMaterial, moduleServices and the test graph are deleted. Owner compositions take the values the old graph bound late at construction. Two compositions stop reaching root glue: the Timetable composition no longer builds the session token reads (the root hands its request session, api.TimetableRequestSession) and the reminder delivery composition no longer builds the shared HTTP runtime (the root hands api.ReminderHTTPRuntime).
affected_tables: None: the same owners run the same statements; only where and when they are constructed changes.
atomic_cutover: One PR: the roots build the owners as local values, the owner compositions take their dependencies at construction, the service graph and its wiring are deleted, and the two keys leave legacy.jsonl.

api, modules and workflows: the suites that drove NewServiceGraphForTests build the typed test roots (api/root_test_root.go), assertions unchanged.
modules/timetable/compose/httpintegration and workflows/reminderdelivery: the suites pass with the root-provided session and HTTP runtime, assertions unchanged.
test ratchets and internal/architecture; scripts/backend-architecture.sh check and validate-ticket --all against the development merge base; scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development.
